req.title: Mark task complete
req.statement: The system shall set completed=true when a PUT payload includes {"completed": true}.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-015 requires that PUT /tasks/{task_id} with {"completed": true} sets completed=true and returns HTTP 2xx with the updated payload. I design: (1) a positive EP test marking an incomplete task complete (task 4, completed=false → true), asserting exact status 200 and completed==True; (2) a positive STC test marking an already-complete task complete again (task 1, completed=true → true), verifying idempotency; (3) a negative NEG test using a non-existent task_id to verify HTTP 404; (4) a negative NEG test sending an invalid payload (title exceeds max length) to verify HTTP 422; (5) a BVA test using task_id=1 (boundary of valid IDs) and task_id=0 (below boundary) to catch off-by-one mutations; (6) a DT test verifying that completed=false in the payload sets completed=False (the opposite boolean branch), catching boolean-negation mutations.

tests.name: test_mark_incomplete_task_complete_returns_200_and_completed_true
preconditions: Task with id=4 exists in DB with completed=false
App is running in-process via TestClient

trace: R-TASK-015: system shall set completed=true when PUT payload includes {"completed": true}
tests.executable:
import os, sys
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite://')
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.database import Base, get_db
from app.main import app
from app import models
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
engine = create_engine('sqlite://', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
db = TestingSessionLocal()
db.add(models.Task(id=4, title='Prepare meeting agenda', description='Harbor matrix prism summit beacon ember matrix.', completed=False))
db.commit()
db.close()
def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()
app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)
def test_mark_incomplete_task_complete_returns_200_and_completed_true():
    r = client.put('/tasks/4', json={'completed': True})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['completed'] == True
    assert body['id'] == 4
    assert body['title'] == 'Prepare meeting agenda'
test_mark_incomplete_task_complete_returns_200_and_completed_true()
